name: Quickened Breath
description: Draw one slow breath and send warm qi through the chest to ease the user's bruised ribs and steady the heartbeat.

name: Kindly Palm
description: Lay a warm palm over an ally's shallow cut and feed qi into it so the edges draw together.

name: Sapflow
description: Spread a thin flow of vitality along an ally's limbs so each step and swing takes less effort.

name: Wristbeat Charting
description: Rest two fingers on an ally's wrist and read the beat of the life within to learn how deep an injury runs.

name: Vital Burst
description: Pack vitality into the palm and release it in one hard shove that drives the target back a full pace.

name: Vigor Guard
description: Thicken the skin of the forearm with vitality so a blow lands on living padding instead of bone.

name: Greenknit
description: Draw qi along a torn muscle of an ally and knit the fibres together with a slow pressing touch.

name: Lifewarm
description: Hold both hands over an ally's chilled body and pour steady warmth through it until the shaking stops.

name: Soothing Draw
description: Press the heel of the hand to an ally's sprained joint and pull the swelling out with a gentle draw of qi.

name: Beat Listening
description: Listen through the palm on an ally's chest for a missing or hurried beat and judge how soon help is needed.

name: Seedling Rush
description: Spring forward on a burst of vitality in the legs to close three paces in a single bound.

name: Verdant Jab
description: Snap a fist forward with vitality packed into the knuckles to land a sharp jolt on the target's chest.

name: Steadfast Stance
description: Sink qi through the soles so the legs drink strength from the ground and hold firm against a shove.

name: Easing Pulse
description: Press qi into the pulse points of an ally in pain to dull the ache and slow a racing heart.

name: Gentle Renewal
description: Trace a slow circle over an ally's bruise with qi-warmed fingers until the dark discolouring pales.

name: Loaned Vigor
description: Lend a measure of the user's own vitality to a flagging ally so the ally stands and fights on.

name: Lifesight
description: Open the senses to the glow of life in the bodies ahead to judge who is hurt and who is whole.

name: Surge Fist
description: Drive a closed fist forward on a sudden surge of vitality so the blow lands with the full weight of the body.

name: Bracing Bloom
description: Flush vitality through the guarding arm at the instant of impact so the bone bears the blow without cracking.

name: Wellspring Touch
description: Rest a hand on an ally's wound and let a steady stream of vitality run into it until the bleeding slows.

name: Soft Bloom
description: Spread a soft wave of warmth over an ally's scraped skin so the raw patches close and fade.

name: Calm Marrow
description: Send qi deep into an ally's bruised bone to quiet the ache and begin the slow knitting.

name: Fresh Surge
description: Hand a tired ally a fresh surge of vitality so aching legs carry on at a steady run.

name: Life Glimpse
description: Let the senses widen to the warm glow of living bodies nearby and note where each one is hurt.

name: Sprightly Step
description: Push off the back foot with a pulse of vitality in the calf to leap clear of a low sweep.

name: Heartbeat Strike
description: Time a straight palm strike to the beat of the user's heart so the force lands with the whole body behind it.

name: Living Ward
description: Hold a hand before the chest and gather vitality into a thin warm barrier that dulls a glancing blow.

name: Steady Knit
description: Hold a steady flow of qi against a long gash on an ally until the flesh begins to close.

name: Pulse Balm
description: Warm both palms with vitality and press them to an ally's swollen bruise to draw the heat and pain away.

name: Vigor Share
description: Pass a measure of the user's own vigor to an ally across a held hand to lift a sinking effort.

name: Drumming Fist
description: Hammer the fist forward in time with the pulse so each blow lands heavier than the last.

name: Evergreen Guard
description: Raise both forearms with vitality flowing through them so a strike is blunted by living flesh.

name: Binding Warmth
description: Wrap an ally's wound in a band of warm qi that holds the edges together while the flesh mends.

name: Hushing Touch
description: Lay fingertips over an ally's racing heartbeat and slow it with calm qi until the panic fades.

name: Clearing Breath
description: Breathe qi into a winded ally so the chest opens and clear steady breath returns.

name: Skin Renewal
description: Sweep a hand across an ally's scraped or scalded skin to coax fresh healthy layers up from beneath.

name: Bright Pulse
description: Send a faint pulse of qi into an ally and feel it echo back to find where the body is weakest.

name: Fortifying Warmth
description: Settle a layer of warm vitality over an ally's body so fresh strength lasts through a long effort.

name: Cradlehold Ward
description: Cup both hands before an ally and hold a soft barrier of vitality that catches a thrown stone.

name: Rising Sap
description: Draw vitality up from the user's centre and push it into an ally's sore limb until the stiffness eases.

name: Sapwarm
description: Spread gentle heat from the palms across an ally's cramped back to loosen the muscles and calm the pain.

name: Lively Limbs
description: Brush qi along an ally's arms and legs to wake tired muscle and bring back a quick step.

name: Sap Tracing
description: Follow the thin trails of vitality in an ally's body with a light touch to find a hidden bruise or break.

name: Whipping Arm
description: Whip the arm out with vitality running down its length so the open hand slaps the target hard.

name: Bounding Step
description: Rebound off the front foot with a pulse of vitality to slide out of the line of an incoming cut.

name: Green Breath
description: Breathe slowly and send the green warmth of living qi through the user to close scrapes and clear a heavy head.

name: Seamweave
description: Weave thin threads of qi across a clean cut on an ally to hold it shut while the flesh grows.

name: Cooling Draw
description: Draw heat and swelling out of an ally's injured joint with a cool pull of qi from the palm.

name: Piercing Pulse
description: Focus vitality to a point on two fingertips and jab it through a gap in the target's guard.

name: Quickening Palm
description: Strike with an open palm and let the sudden surge of vitality stagger the target's footing.

name: Vital Shell
description: Gather vitality in a close shell along the ribs so a kick glances off without breaking them.

name: Breath Jolt
description: Jolt a target's gathering breath with an abrupt pulse of qi to the chest so its next move breaks off.

name: Living Warmth
description: Pour a slow tide of warmth from both palms into an ally's torso until pain and chill ease together.

name: Tending Hold
description: Hold a weak ally upright in both arms while steady qi eases the dizziness and sickness.

name: Lent Warmth
description: Press a warm palm to an ally's back and lend the heat so numb limbs wake and move freely.

name: Soft Landing
description: Cushion a fall with a burst of vitality in the legs and roll out of it ready to move.

name: Pulsing Guard
description: Beat vitality outward through the skin in time with the heart so each blow is met by a springing rebound.

name: Waking Blow
description: Drive a short blow into the target's breastbone that carries a sharp surge of vitality to rattle its balance.

name: Seedwarm
description: Cup a small ball of warm qi in the palm and press it into an ally's bruise to fade the ache.

name: Tender Knit
description: Guide fine threads of qi through an ally's torn skin so the wound closes without a scar.

name: Budding Ease
description: Open the closed fingers of a cramped hand with a release of qi that lets blood and feeling return.

name: Seed Sense
description: Reach out a thread of qi to the living things nearby and count how many breathe and how strongly.

name: Sprouting Vigor
description: Coax a slow rise of vitality through an ally's body until weary muscles tense and ready themselves again.

name: Shoot Strike
description: Shoot a straight punch from the hip with vitality uncoiling through the arm to hit the target's guard.

name: Faltering Touch
description: Touch the target's wrist and cut the flow of its qi for a heartbeat so its blow loses force.
